publish.note: A roundup whose headline says nothing of the building, and a second account of the opening the Chronicle finding 2026-11-08-sc-0001 carries (itself pending: 300 Jefferson cannot be joined to one parcel).

resolution.method: sf-eas-addresses has 300 JEFFERSON ST but it does not join to one parcel. 300 JEFFERSON ST's coordinates fall in 2 active parcels (0006001, 9900047) that are not one condominium's units, so none of them is the building by rule.
resolution.note: The address exists but cannot be joined to a parcel, so there is no page to put it on. EAS leaves addresses unparcelled for rear units, vacated lots and addresses in flux; a later pass may find one.
